page.layout: One page of text, single column; a narrow fragment of the facing page at the far left edge (not transcribed as text). No margin notes.

main_text.head: In Epistolam ad Colossenses.
main_text.p: COLOSS. c 1. v. 2. Τοῖς ἐν Κολοσσαῖς ἁγίοις καὶ πιστοῖς &c. ἅγιοι & πιστοὶ sunt viri sibi is Ecclesia in Colossis.

V. 27. Οἷς ἠθέλησεν ὁ Θεὸς γνωρίσαι τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τοῦ μυστηρίου τούτου ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὅς ἐστι Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς δόξης &c. Ut constructio fiat, ὅς absque dubio est relativum voci πλούτου. Quibus voluit Deus notum facere quae sit opulentia gloriae huius mysterii inter gentes, quae est Christus inter vos, spes gloriae.
C. 2. v. 14. Ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθ' ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον, τοῖς δόγμασιν ὁ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν. Expungens quod adversum nos erat Chirographum, quod erat in traditionibus nobis contrarium.

V. 18. Μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς καταβραβευέτω θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ θρησκείᾳ τῶν ἀγγέλων, ἃ μὴ ἑώρακεν ἐμβατεύων. Nemo vos subdola argumentatione fallat, qui delectatur in humilitate & cultu Angelorum, ingrediens in ea quae non vidit, temere inflatus à sensu carnis suae. καταβραβευέτω, ἐμβατεύων. Phavor. θέλω, ἐνδοχῶ: ibidem. ut Mar. 12. 38. & Psal. 147. 10, ἐμβατεύων Hieronymus & Erasmus vertunt fastuose incedens in ea quae non vidit, i.e. audens differere vel affirmare de iis quae non vidit, vel intelligit, temere inflatus à suâ ipsius carnali phantasiâ.

page.notes: Greek text is printed with heavy wear and several words are uncertain; Greek accents and breathings in the lines of verse 18 and 27 are approximate. The marginal fragment at the left edge is show-through/facing page and is not transcribed. The signature "L" and "V. 22." at the foot are printed beneath the text block.
